verdict.rationale: Porkbun's first-party API docs explicitly promise full create/read/update/delete over DNS records, including the TXT records needed for ACME DNS-01. Surrounding automation support is strong: a sandbox key, keyless /mock endpoints, per-domain and per-IP scoped keys, and signed webhooks for DNS changes. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that DNS CRUD works as documented, explicit ACME/DNS-01 challenge guidance (TXT support is only implied for this use), and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404s).
